body.error: This project files NDA, and Module 3 is composed here only for a US IND (21 CFR 312.23(a)(7)). A marketing application needs the 3.2.R location statements, the §3.2.S.4.5 / §3.2.P.5.6 justification of specification and 4-level section granularity, none of which this composer produces; an EU or Health Canada clinical-trial application needs an IMPD Quality part, which is not CTD Module 3. Author its quality content in Document editor & authoring, keep the evidence in Vault (DMS), and file it through the Submission center.
